hypothesis: Can Qwen recover complete answers when every model call handles exactly one fact: locate one message, then extract one fact, while ordinary code performs the final join?
boundary: Development diagnostic on the five Gate 16D.6 failures. Fact decomposition is human-frozen and is not tested here.
pipeline: Human freezes one-fact questions before inference.
Locator sees one fact question and one whole conversation; it returns exactly one message ID or EMPTY.
Extractor sees one fact question and only that one selected message; it returns one short fact.
Ordinary code joins the facts in the frozen order. No model merger is used.
